extDescription.message: Save pages, posts and repos in one click, keep them on this device, and hand them to an AI for explanation later.

extractPartial.message: Only part of the page could be captured

extractFailed.message: Page text could not be captured. The URL and title are saved.

errorNoTab.message: There is no page to save in this tab.

localOnly.message: Data is stored only in this browser.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search title, URL, notes and text

emptyList.message: Nothing saved yet. Press “Scrap this page” to start.

memoPlaceholder.message: Note (why you saved it, what to try)

noFragments.message: No text was saved for this item.

confirmDeleteForever.message: This deletes the item with its fragments and AI answers. This cannot be undone.

confirmBulkDelete.message: This deletes {0} items with their fragments and AI answers. This cannot be undone.

confirmDeleteCategory.message: Delete the category “{0}”? Items are kept and only lose this category.

maxCharsHelp.message: Applies to newly saved pages. Leave empty for no limit.

localOnlyLong.message: Data is stored only in this browser on this computer and is not synced. To move it to another computer or browser, use Export and Import below.

pickElement.message: Pick an element on the page

pickerTip.message: Click the part to save (↑↓ adjusts the range, Esc cancels)

sitesIntro.message: Choose where to extract from (CSS selectors) and the character limit for each site. If nothing matches, ScrapAI falls back to normal article extraction.

pickAddToProfile.message: Add as a field to the profile being edited

profileSelectHint.message: Select a profile from the list.

profilePatternsHelp.message: Example: x.com/** or *.2chan.net/b/res/*  (* is one path level, ** is the rest, a leading *. matches subdomains. Query strings are ignored)

profileFieldsHelp.message: Each field is saved as one fragment. If an attribute is set (e.g. href), its value is taken instead of the text.

profileUnitUse.message: Use a repeating unit such as replies or posts

profileUnitHelp.message: With no selection, this page's post (or the first unit) is saved. Selecting across several units saves each unit as its own fragment.

confirmProfileReset.message: Reset this profile to its default content?

confirmProfileDelete.message: Delete profile "{0}"? Saved items are kept.

confirmDiscard.message: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

aiPastePlaceholder.message: Paste the AI's answer here and press "Save answer". The original text is always kept, even if the headings differ.

aiPasteHint.message: Use the copy button under the answer to keep its headings intact

aiRawOnlyNote.message: The headings could not be read, so the original text is kept as is.

templatesIntro.message: Prompts to give the AI, chosen by what you want to do. Duplicate a built-in one to edit it freely. Placeholders you can use:

exportHelp.message: Writes what you choose into one JSON file. Scraps and fragments are always included.

importDuplicate.message: When a scrap with the same URL exists

importError_invalidJson.message: Could not read the file as JSON. Nothing was changed.

importError_invalidFormat.message: Not a ScrapAI export file. Nothing was changed.

importError_unsupportedVersion.message: This file is from a newer version. Please update the extension. Nothing was changed.

importError_invalidData.message: The file contents are invalid. Nothing was changed.

settingsContextMenu.message: Add “Save to ScrapAI” to the right-click menu

settingsContextMenuHelp.message: Turning this on asks the browser to allow the context menu permission. If text is selected it is added as a fragment. Off by default.

settingsShortcutsHelp.message: Keyboard shortcuts work once you assign keys (none are assigned by default). In Chrome’s shortcut settings, assign keys to “Scrap this page” and “Open the ScrapAI manager”. A ✓ appears on the icon after saving.

aiApplyHeadline.message: Replace the title with the answer’s headline

aiAnswerSavedTitled.message: Answer saved and the title replaced with its headline.

aiPromptLangHelp.message: EN: instructions in English, answer in your language. Native: instructions in your language.

snapshotRemember.message: Always take one on this site

snapshotFailed.message: Could not take a snapshot (reload the page and save again)

snapshotAlt.message: Cut-out of the page when saved

profileSnapshotHelp.message: Keep part of the page as an image when saving. Only the visible part of the screen is captured. Use “@unit” to capture the saved unit (such as a post) itself.

snapWhen.message: Only when this element is inside (empty = always)

panelKeepOpenHelp.message: When off, the side panel closes when you click back on the page

translateUnavailable.message: This Chrome has no built-in Translator API

setTemporaryChat.message: Open AI services in a temporary chat

setTemporaryChatHelp.message: Not kept in history and less affected by past conversations. AI services without a temporary chat open a normal chat.

importHelp.message: Reads an exported JSON file. Invalid files are rejected without changing anything.

aiTitleBadge.message: Showing the headline from the AI answer

syncIntro.message: Use the same scraps on several computers. No server is used: each computer writes its own file into a folder that the Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive desktop app keeps in sync, and reads the others.

syncStep1.message: Prepare a folder that the Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive desktop app syncs with this computer (for example, a “ScrapAI” folder in My Drive).

syncStep2.message: Choose that folder with the button below and allow editing.

syncStep3.message: Choose the same folder on your other computers and their saves will be combined.

syncReallowHelp.message: After Chrome restarts, you need to allow access to the folder again.

syncDone.message: Synced (read {0} other computers, {1} added or updated, {2} removed).

syncFailed.message: Could not sync. Check that the folder is available and try again.

syncNeedPermission.message: Access to the folder is not allowed. Click “Allow access”.

syncUnsupported.message: This browser cannot choose folders (desktop Chrome or Edge is required).

syncAuto.message: While the manager is open, it syncs every minute and when you come back to it.

aiDirectOpened.message: Opened {0} with the prompt filled in. When the answer appears, click “Save to ScrapAI” at the bottom right.

bridgeNotFound.message: No answer found yet. Click after the answer finishes (or copy it and paste it into ScrapAI).

bridgeFailed.message: Could not save. Copy the answer and paste it into ScrapAI.

bridgeFilled.message: ScrapAI filled in the prompt. Check it and send.

setAiDirect.message: One-click handoff to the AI and back

setAiDirectHelp.message: Fills the prompt into the AI service and shows a button to bring the answer back. The first time, it asks for access to that AI service. It looks for the input box and the answer automatically even if the site changes; if it fails, copy and paste still works.

bulkHint.message: Select items to act on them

aiRunHelp.message: Opens the AI tab in the background, asks for a summary and imports it (the tab closes on success)

aiRunFailedHelp.message: Could not import automatically. Press again, or use "Import to ScrapAI" on the opened tab

bridgeAuto.message: ScrapAI is working on it and will import the answer once it is complete

aiIntro.message: Settings for the card "Summarize" button and the "Ask" section of the detail view.

aiButtonHelp.message: With an AI service, ScrapAI opens a tab in the background, sends the prompt, imports the answer when it is complete and closes the tab. With the Gemini API it imports without opening a tab.

geminiHelp.message: Enter a free-tier API key (from Google AI Studio) to summarize without opening a tab. The key stays on this device and is not included in sync or export.

geminiPrivacy.message: When you use the Gemini API, the text of the material is sent to Google's servers. You will be asked for access the first time.

svcHelp.message: You can change the built-in AI services too. Leave the input box, send button and answer locations (CSS selectors) empty to find them automatically; set them only if it does not work.

svcClose.message: Close the tab after the AI button imports the answer

bridgeNotSent.message: Could not send. Press the send button here (then "Import to ScrapAI" when the answer appears)

svcBackground.message: Open in a background tab for the AI button (turn off if sending does not work)

geminiApiTitle.message: Ask the Gemini API (imports the answer without opening a tab)

geminiNoKey.message: No Gemini API key yet. Enter it in the AI settings of the manager

translatePair.message: This language pair cannot be translated

translateFailed.message: Translation failed. It may still be getting ready; wait a moment and press again

geminiKeyHint.message: Usually starts with "AIza…" or "AQ.…" (issued in Google AI Studio).

geminiKeyBad.message: This does not look like an API key. Check for spaces or line breaks and that you copied all of it.

geminiModelsCount.message: {0} models available. Click the field to choose
